Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, CoinTracker serves millions of users through direct subscriptions and partnerships with TurboTax and leading exchanges that embed its calculations. The company sits at the intersection of finance, data engineering and regulatory compliance. Backed by leading investors, it emphasizes accuracy and customer trust. Expect a compliance and product-focused culture that values data correctness, thoughtful UX for complex tax workflows and helping users stay compliant with minimal friction.

aspora.name: Aspora
aspora.description: Aspora, founded in 2022 and building from hubs in India, the UK, the UAE, Europe and the United States, is a borderless financial platform for people who live and work across countries. Its products combine remittances, multi-currency accounts and card spending with compliance and banking partnerships so diaspora customers can move, hold and spend money with transparent pricing. Backed by investors including Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator and Global Founders Capital, Aspora emphasizes extreme ownership, fast shipping and turning regulatory complexity into simple user experiences. Expect a product- and compliance-heavy culture that values design craft, payments reliability and customer impact across global corridors.

spruce.name: Spruce
spruce.description: Spruce, founded in 2020 by Wayne Chang and Gregory Rocco in New York, builds open-source identity and data control infrastructure for Web3. Its products, SpruceID and Kepler, provide decentralized identifiers, credential wallets and storage that let users control authentication and data sharing across apps without centralized providers, using DIDs and verifiable credentials. Headquartered in New York with a distributed team, Spruce collaborates with Ethereum Foundation, ENS and government pilots on privacy-preserving identity standards. The company emphasizes open standards, cryptographic verifiability and developer tooling over custodial identity. Backed by leading investors, Spruce advances self-sovereign identity research and interoperability. Its standards collaborations with ENS, Ethereum Foundation and government pilots advance verifiable credential adoption while preserving user control over selective disclosure. Expect a research and standards-driven culture that values privacy engineering, open collaboration and building durable, user-controlled identity rails for the ecosystem.

proof.name: Proof
proof.description: Proof is a litigation services platform used by law firms to access a nationwide network of vetted process servers for document delivery and e-filing. Its about page describes Proof as a legal technology company reimagining efficiency with modern, automated solutions, and its structured data cites an on-demand process serving platform with real-time tracking. Proof was founded in 2017 and operates with hubs including Denver, Detroit, and New York.

consensys.name: Consensys
consensys.description: Consensys, founded in 2014 by Joseph Lubin, co-founder of Ethereum, in Brooklyn, builds core infrastructure for the Ethereum ecosystem. Its products include MetaMask, the most widely used self-custody wallet serving millions, Infura, the node and API suite powering most dApps, and Linea, a ZK-rollup for scaling. The company also stewards developer tools including Truffle, Besu and Diligence audits for enterprises, governments and protocol teams worldwide. Headquartered in Brooklyn with hubs in London, Paris and globally distributed, Consensys blends product engineering, protocol research and enterprise consulting. Backed by leading investors and enterprise partners, it advances decentralized web standards and ecosystem growth. Expect a mission-driven culture that values Ethereum advocacy, product craftsmanship and building durable, trusted rails for users and developers to access Web3 safely.

offchain-labs.name: Offchain Labs
offchain-labs.description: Offchain Labs, founded in 2018 in Princeton by Ed Felten, Steven Goldfeder and Harry Kalodner, builds Arbitrum, the leading Ethereum layer-2 scaling suite including Arbitrum One and Nova. Originating from Princeton research on optimistic rollups and fraud proofs, Arbitrum secures significant total value and powers much of layer-2 decentralized finance activity with low fees and Ethereum settlement. The company licenses technology from Princeton, employs rigorous systems engineering and ecosystem grants to expand developer adoption across custom Orbit Chains. Headquartered in Princeton and New York with remote colleagues, Offchain is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed and Pantera. The team blends academic rigor, distributed systems expertise and ecosystem growth to scale Ethereum without compromising security or developer experience for builders globally today.

relay.name: Relay
relay.description: Relay, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware as Relay Link and formerly Reservoir, builds cross-chain payments and bridging infrastructure for instant token movement. Its protocol aggregates bridges and solvers to route user intents into single-click transfers that settle across Ethereum, L2s and Solana with minimal slippage and gas abstraction. Developers integrate Relay's API and widget to let users pay from any chain without manual bridging, custody or wrapped assets. Operating with a distributed team across the US, Relay emphasizes low-latency routing, solver economics and reliable settlement for wallets, marketplaces and consumer apps. The platform supports significant bridged volume through partner integrations. Expect a developer-centric culture focused on routing reliability, UX simplicity and helping builders hide chain complexity behind fast payments.

allium.name: Allium
allium.description: Allium, founded in 2021 by Ethan Chan and Cheng Han Lee, former engineering leaders at Meta and Primer, in New York, provides enterprise blockchain data infrastructure for institutions. Its platform ingests, normalizes and indexes data from numerous chains to deliver real-time analytics, compliance queries and warehouse-ready datasets for banks, fintechs and crypto firms. Clients use Allium to monitor stablecoin flows, decode smart contracts and power dashboards without running nodes. Backed by leading investors including Theory Ventures and Kleiner Perkins, Allium emphasizes data accuracy, low-latency pipelines and SQL accessibility for analysts. Headquartered in New York with a distributed engineering team, the company bridges Web2 data expectations with on-chain complexity. Expect a data-obsessed culture that values pipeline reliability, customer-driven product and turning raw blocks into actionable intelligence.

bitvavo.name: Bitvavo
bitvavo.description: Bitvavo, founded in 2018 by Tim Baardse, Jelle de Boer and William Boersma in Amsterdam, operates a leading European crypto exchange and brokerage for retail and high-volume traders. Its platform offers spot trading, staking and custody across a broad range of assets with EUR rails, FIX and REST APIs, and institutional custody via Bitvavo Custody. Headquartered in Amsterdam with hubs across the Netherlands, Bitvavo is registered with the Dutch Central Bank as a digital asset service provider and emphasizes fee transparency, orderbook depth and euro liquidity. Serving a broad European retail and professional base, the company focuses on reliable matching, compliance and local support. Backed by growth capital, Bitvavo competes on pricing and reliability. Expect a compliance and execution-focused culture that values platform stability, transparent operations and expanding regulated crypto access in Europe.

river-financial.name: River Financial
river-financial.description: River Financial is an enterprise-grade Bitcoin financial services firm and Lightning Network infrastructure provider offering zero-fee recurring Bitcoin purchases, institutional custody, and Bitcoin mining integration. Its River Lightning API enables banks, fintechs, and crypto platforms to integrate instant, low-cost Lightning Network payments with turn-key node liquidity. Privately funded and US-licensed, River values Bitcoin standard conviction, financial infrastructure reliability, high-touch client support, and security architecture. River Financial combines zero-fee Bitcoin accumulation, enterprise Lightning Network infrastructure APIs, and institutional custody, empowering clients to build on a pure Bitcoin standard.

trilitech.name: Trilitech
trilitech.description: Trilitech develops technology and applications for the Tezos blockchain from its London team, supporting core protocol development, adoption, and builders across the ecosystem. Its site highlights core development on the Tezos protocol, adoption through applications and partnerships, and entrepreneurship programs that help founders bring ideas to market on Tezos. Trilitech also works with startups, creators, and brands on commercial engagements within the Tezos network.

morpho.name: Morpho
morpho.description: Morpho is a decentralized lending protocol on Ethereum and Base that optimizes interest rates for borrowers and lenders by matching supply and demand peer-to-peer while falling back on underlying liquidity pools like Compound and Aave. Known for its permissionless Morpho Blue primitives and vault architecture, Morpho prioritizes formal verification, smart contract security, and capital efficiency. Morpho Blue provides permissionless lending primitives that allow risk managers and DeFi protocols to deploy isolated lending markets with customizable collateral parameters and dynamic interest rate curves. Morpho matches supply and demand peer-to-peer while falling back on underlying liquidity pools like Compound and Aave, prioritizing formal verification, smart contract security, and capital efficiency.

animoca-brands.name: Animoca Brands
animoca-brands.description: Animoca Brands, founded in 2014 by Yat Siu in Hong Kong, is a leading Web3 gaming, metaverse and digital property company. Through investments in a broad portfolio of companies and products including The Sandbox, Phantom Galaxies and Mocaverse, it champions digital ownership via NFTs and tokens. The firm operates publishing, advisory and investment arms that help studios launch token economies and marketplaces serving a wide player base. Headquartered in Hong Kong with offices in Singapore, London and Sydney, Animoca blends game development, IP partnerships and on-chain infrastructure. Backed by leading investors including Temasek and Sequoia China, it advocates for an open metaverse. Expect a creative, entrepreneurial culture that values gaming craft, community ownership and building the infrastructure for an inclusive, player-owned internet today.

falconx.name: FalconX
falconx.description: FalconX, founded in 2018 in San Mateo by Raghu Yarlagadda and Prabhakar Reddy, is an institutional prime brokerage combining trading, credit and custody for funds, corporates and protocols. Its over-the-counter and derivatives desk provides deep liquidity across many assets with post-trade settlement, treasury management and risk analytics that let clients trade without pre-funding venues. Backed by leading investors including Accel, American Express Ventures and Tiger Global, FalconX holds regulatory registrations in the United States and expands across Asia Pacific. Headquartered in San Mateo with hubs in New York, Bangalore and Malta and a global team, the firm processes significant monthly volume for professional desks. The culture is markets-driven, engineering-focused and centered on institutional reliability, capital efficiency and navigating volatile crypto markets with disciplined risk.

newton.name: Newton
newton.description: Newton Protocol, developed by Magic Labs founded in 2018 by Sean Li and Jaemin Jin in San Francisco with the Magic Newton Foundation established in October 2024, builds verifiable automation infrastructure for AI agents and on-chain actions. Its core protocol combines trusted execution environments with zero-knowledge proofs to let agents execute cross-chain intents, rebalancing and DeFi workflows under user-defined zkPermissions with spending limits and allowlists. Designed for chain abstraction, Newton abstracts gas and signing while enforcing transparent constraints auditable on-chain. Headquartered in San Francisco with a foundation presence in the Cayman Islands and a distributed research team, Newton operates at the intersection of AI, cryptography and decentralized finance through partner integrations with wallets and rollups. Expect a research-heavy culture that values protocol correctness, thoughtful agent design and shipping reliable automation for everyday crypto users.

anchorage-digital.name: Anchorage Digital
anchorage-digital.description: Anchorage Digital, founded in 2017 in San Francisco by Diogo Mónica and Nathan McCauley, is the only federally chartered crypto bank in the United States through Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. regulated by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. Its custody uses biometric authentication and threshold cryptography, supporting custody, staking, trading and governance for institutions without single points of failure. The platform serves funds, corporates and protocols with insured, SOC-audited infrastructure and additional licensing via New York BitLicense and Singapore operations. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs and KKR, Anchorage sets the standard for regulated digital asset banking. Headquartered in San Francisco with hubs in New York, Porto, Singapore and Sioux Falls, the culture blends crypto-native product with bank-grade compliance and risk discipline.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Alchemy, founded in 2017 in San Francisco by Nikil Viswanathan and Joe Lau, Stanford classmates and former teaching assistants, is a leading Web3 developer platform providing node infrastructure, Supernode and Notify APIs. The stack powers many top Ethereum applications and handles significant transaction volume for customers including major exchanges and consumer apps, with high uptime and scalable archival data. Valued highly after rapid growth, the company serves developers through reliable APIs, enhanced data and educational programs that reduce need to run nodes directly. Headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York and distributed colleagues, Alchemy invests in developer experience, documentation and enterprise reliability. The culture is engineering-obsessed, docs-first and focused on making every developer a Web3 developer with dependable tooling.

solflare.name: Solflare
solflare.description: Solflare, founded in 2021 by Vidor Gencel and Filip Dragoslavic as a community-built Solana wallet, provides a leading non-custodial wallet for Solana and emerging ecosystems. Available as browser extension, mobile and web, it offers staking, swaps, NFT gallery and Ledger support with direct integration to Solana dApps. Serving a broad user base as one of the original Solana ecosystem wallets, Solflare is non-custodial, audited and focused on Solana-native UX with transaction simulation and phishing warnings. Headquartered with a distributed team across Croatia, Serbia and globally remote, Solflare maintains close collaboration with the Solana Foundation and validator community. Backed by ecosystem grants and community growth, it emphasizes self-sovereignty. Expect a community-driven culture centered on Solana advocacy, security mindfulness and delivering fast, accessible wallet experiences for everyday users.

ether-fi.name: ether.fi
ether-fi.description: ether.fi, founded in 2022 by Mike Silagadze, founder of Top Hat, and Rok Kopp with headquarters in Grand Cayman, operates a leading decentralized liquid restaking protocol on Ethereum. Its eETH and weETH tokens let users stake ether while retaining liquidity and earning EigenLayer restaking rewards plus native yield, secured through distributed validator technology. Governance is via ETHFI token, and the protocol emphasizes non-custodial design where stakers retain key control. Securing significant TVL across Ethereum, ether.fi is audited and backed by leading investors including Bullish and CoinFund. Headquartered with a distributed team across North America and Cayman, the project blends DeFi engineering with staking operations. Expect a security-conscious culture focused on validator reliability, transparent risk and expanding restaked yield opportunities for holders.

uniswap-labs.name: Uniswap Labs
uniswap-labs.description: Uniswap Labs, founded in 2018 by Hayden Adams in New York, builds the leading decentralized exchange protocol and interfaces for Ethereum and EVM chains. Originating from the Uniswap v1 automated market maker, the Labs developed successive protocol versions including v2, v3 concentrated liquidity and v4 hooks, plus the Uniswap Wallet and UniswapX routing. Its interfaces route billions in monthly volume via smart order routing and aggregation while remaining non-custodial and audited. Headquartered in New York with a distributed team across the US, Uniswap Labs is backed by leading investors and steward of open-source protocol research. The company advances DeFi accessibility and governance via UNI. Expect a product-driven culture focused on mechanism design craft, security review and making self-custody swapping reliable for mainstream users.

trezor.name: Trezor
trezor.description: Trezor, created in 2013 by Marek Palatinus (Slush) and Pavol Rusnak (Stick) under SatoshiLabs in Prague, Czech Republic, is the inventor of the world's first hardware cryptocurrency wallet. Its flagship open-source devices, including Trezor Model One, Trezor Safe 3 and Trezor Safe 5, paired with the Trezor Suite desktop app, provide millions of users across 150+ countries with audited cold-storage security, Shamir backup seed protection and coinjoin privacy. Operating with an uncompromising commitment to open-source hardware and firmware transparency, Trezor values self-custody sovereignty, cypherpunk ethics and rigorous user security. SatoshiLabs' Trezor hardware wallets provide open-source cold storage security, Shamir backup seed protection, and audited firmware transparency for crypto users worldwide.

plasma.name: Plasma
plasma.description: Plasma, founded in 2024 by Paul Faecks and Christian Angermayer and headquartered in London, builds a high-throughput blockchain purpose-built for stablecoin payments. The network optimizes for low fees, fast finality and native issuance of USDT and other dollar stablecoins, with built-in compliance hooks, fiat ramps and treasury tooling for merchants and fintechs. Anchored to Bitcoin via periodic checkpoints and supporting pBTC, Plasma decouples consensus from payments execution to maintain predictable settlement under load. Headquartered in London with a distributed team across the US and Europe and backing from Founders Fund, Framework Ventures and Bitfinex, the project is advancing toward public mainnet and ecosystem partnerships with wallets and neobanks. Expect an execution-driven culture that values payments reliability, regulatory awareness and making stablecoin settlement as seamless as card processing.

asymmetric-research.name: Asymmetric Research
asymmetric-research.description: Asymmetric Research is a premier crypto-native security engineering, smart contract auditing, and quantitative research firm. Founded by former senior engineers and researchers from Jump Crypto, Asymmetric Research specializes in securing high-throughput layer-one blockchains, decentralized bridges, cross-chain messaging infrastructure, and complex DeFi primitives across the Solana and wider multi-chain ecosystems. The team conducts in-depth protocol reviews, formal verification, zero-day vulnerability analysis, and real-time onchain monitoring, serving as a trusted security partner for tier-one protocols and institutional digital asset builders.

braiins.name: Braiins
braiins.description: Braiins, founded in 2011 by Jan Capek and Pavel Moravec in Prague, develops Bitcoin mining software and fleet management around the legacy of Slush Pool, the first Bitcoin mining pool launched in 2010 by Marek Palatinus. Its products include Braiins Pool with Stratum V2, Braiins OS+ firmware for ASIC optimization, and Braiins Toolbox for monitoring and profit switching across large fleets. Headquartered in Prague with a globally distributed team, Braiins serves industrial miners optimizing uptime, efficiency and hashrate transparency since Bitcoin's early years. The firm pioneered open mining standards, Stratum protocol improvements and transparency dashboards after taking over Slush Pool operations in 2013. Operating as a miner-aligned company, it emphasizes firmware correctness and pool reliability over custodial services. Expect an engineering-driven culture that values Bitcoin openness, fleet performance and building practical tooling for professional mining operations at scale.

tools-for-humanity.name: Tools for Humanity
tools-for-humanity.description: Tools for Humanity, founded in 2019 in San Francisco by Sam Altman, Alex Blania and Max Novendstern, builds World, formerly Worldcoin, centered on World ID proof of personhood via the Orb hardware device and the WLD token. The project aims to distinguish humans from AI online while preserving privacy through zero-knowledge proofs and broad global distribution. Adopted by millions of verified humans across many countries, World combines biometric hardware, privacy research and blockchain issuance with a consumer World App for payments and identity. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Khosla Ventures, the organization operates hardware manufacturing and operator logistics at unusual scale. Headquartered in San Francisco and Berlin with hubs in Munich and Erlangen, the culture blends product, privacy engineering and global operations with careful rollout.

opensea.name: OpenSea
opensea.description: OpenSea, founded in December 2017 by Devin Finzer and Alex Atallah in New York, pioneered the market for NFT trading and remains a leading peer-to-peer marketplace for digital collectibles. Its platform supports Ethereum, Polygon, Base and other EVM chains, offering listing, bidding, aggregation, drops and creator analytics with wallet-based settlement and royalty controls. Now headquartered in Miami with hubs in New York and San Francisco, OpenSea served as the primary venue through the 2021 NFT cycle and has since expanded to token swaps, studio tools and mobile. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Paradigm at a $13.3B peak valuation, the company emphasizes marketplace reliability, trust and safety, and creator tooling. Expect a marketplace-driven culture that values curation, product iteration and maintaining reliable trading infrastructure through volatile collector demand.

mesh.name: Mesh
mesh.description: Mesh, founded in 2020 in San Francisco by Bam Azizi with co-founder Adam Israel, builds embedded crypto payments and account aggregation via Mesh Connect. The platform enables hundreds of consumer and fintech apps to move assets without exposing keys, offering smart funding and conversion APIs that power transfers inside wallets including PayPal and others. Through a single integration, businesses can connect to hundreds of exchanges and wallets for deposits, payouts and stablecoin settlement with secure multiparty computation. Backed by leading investors including Galaxy, Mesh emphasizes self-custody, security audits and one-click user experience. Headquartered in San Francisco with hubs in New York and distributed remote talent, the team focuses on connecting every account to every app with minimal friction and reliable operations.

trust-wallet.name: Trust Wallet
trust-wallet.description: Trust Wallet, originally founded in 2017 by Viktor Radchenko in San Francisco and acquired by Binance in 2018, is a leading self-custody, multichain wallet serving a broad global audience. Supporting numerous chains and a wide range of assets including EVM, Bitcoin, Solana and Cosmos, it offers in-app swaps, staking, WalletConnect and NFT management with no account or custody. Fully non-custodial and open-source, Trust Wallet emphasizes user ownership, security audits and browser extension plus mobile parity. Headquartered with hubs in Dubai and distributed globally under Binance's portfolio but operating independently, Trust Wallet is available in many languages. The product focuses on accessibility for newcomers and power for advanced users. Expect a user-first culture that values simplicity, security education and empowering individuals to manage crypto independently.

elwood-technologies.name: Elwood Technologies
elwood-technologies.description: Elwood Technologies is an institutional digital asset technology platform founded by Alan Howard, providing tier-one financial institutions, asset managers, and hedge funds with high-performance crypto trading, execution, portfolio management, and risk analytics software via a unified API. Elwood Technologies provides institutional investors, tier-one banks, and asset managers with unified API connectivity for high-performance crypto trading, execution, and portfolio risk management. Founded by Alan Howard, Elwood delivers enterprise-grade trading software, liquidity aggregation, and portfolio analytics across digital asset venues.

bit2me.name: Bit2Me
bit2me.description: Bit2Me is a Spain-based cryptocurrency platform offering exchange services, wallets, and institutional products for users and businesses across Europe. Licensed and supervised under European frameworks, it provides euro on-ramps, trading, educational content, and API integrations for partners embedding crypto services. Bit2Me also supports B2B white-label and custody offerings for fintechs expanding into digital assets with compliance tooling. Teams span engineering, compliance, marketing, and customer operations with headquarters in Spain and remote roles across the EU. Expect a growth-oriented culture that balances retail accessibility with regulatory compliance and dependable platform operations for European crypto users.

bitbank.name: bitbank
bitbank.description: bitbank, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Tokyo, is one of Japan's leading licensed cryptocurrency exchanges, offering yen-denominated spot trading, staking, and custody for retail and institutional clients. The platform emphasizes security, transparent order books, and compliance with Japan's Financial Services Agency oversight for digital asset service providers. bitbank provides API access for professional traders, portfolio tools for long-term holders, and educational resources for newcomers entering crypto through regulated channels. As one of the most recognized domestic brands in Japanese crypto, it focuses on dependable uptime and customer support during volatile markets. Teams span engineering, risk, compliance, and client operations in Tokyo and remote hubs. Expect a meticulous, regulation-aware culture that values operational reliability and building trust with Japanese retail and professional market participants.

pwc.name: PwC
pwc.description: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers) provides global audit, tax, legal, advisory, and Web3 consulting services, delivering digital asset audit assurance, blockchain strategy, and smart contract compliance solutions to enterprise clients worldwide.

kaiko.name: Kaiko
kaiko.description: Kaiko is a market data and analytics company providing institutional-grade crypto trade, order book, and derivatives data across centralized and decentralized venues. Funds, banks, regulators, and researchers use Kaiko feeds for pricing benchmarks, surveillance, risk modeling, and academic market structure studies. The company normalizes messy exchange APIs into audited datasets with historical depth and low-latency delivery options. Headquartered in Paris with offices in New York and London, Kaiko partners with both traditional finance and crypto-native institutions. Expect a data engineering culture focused on accuracy, coverage expansion, and helping clients trust crypto market inputs for production systems.

primexbt.name: PrimeXBT
primexbt.description: PrimeXBT, founded in 2018 in Victoria, Seychelles, is an established cryptocurrency and synthetic derivatives trading exchange serving global retail and institutional traders. The platform offers spot digital asset trading, margin perpetual futures, copy trading engines, and cross-asset liquidity within a single unified trading account. PrimeXBT emphasizes institutional liquidity integration, multi-signature cold storage custody, low-latency execution, and comprehensive technical analysis suites for active crypto traders.

hex-trust.name: Hex Trust
hex-trust.description: Hex Trust, founded in 2018 by Alessio Quaglini and Rafal Czerniawski in Hong Kong, provides licensed digital asset custody, staking and markets services for institutions. As a fully licensed custodian in Hong Kong and Dubai and registered in Europe, it offers bank-grade vaults, MPC wallets and compliance tooling for banks, funds and corporates holding crypto and tokenized assets. Its Hex Safe platform supports numerous chains and integrates DeFi, NFT and settlement workflows with insurance coverage. Backed by leading investors including Animoca Brands and SBI, Hex Trust bridges traditional finance and on-chain infrastructure with a focus on regulation. Headquartered in Hong Kong with offices in Dubai, Singapore and across Europe. Expect a security-focused culture that values licensing craft, operational rigor and building trusted rails for institutional adoption.

fomo-labs.name: Fomo Labs
fomo-labs.description: Fomo (fomo.family) is a social-first crypto trading platform available on mobile and the web. According to the company's site, users can swap memecoins, altcoins, and stablecoins in seconds, follow other traders, and copy trades from one shared account that syncs across phone and desktop. Fomo positions itself as a social trading app aimed at casual and active crypto participants rather than institutional terminals. Open roles at Fomo Labs are listed on the company's Ashby board; product and engineering hiring focuses on mobile, web trading flows, and social discovery features described on fomo.family.

dakota.name: Dakota
dakota.description: Dakota is a business banking and treasury management platform built specifically for Web3 startups, protocols, and DAOs. Offering high-yield USD treasury accounts, automated yield strategies, free global wire transfers, and corporate cards, Dakota bridges traditional commercial banking with crypto-native operations. Dakota provides corporate crypto banking, yield-bearing USD treasury accounts, and global payout rails built specifically for Web3 startups, protocols, and decentralized organizations. Offering automated yield strategies, zero-fee wire transfers, and corporate cards, Dakota bridges traditional commercial banking with crypto-native financial operations. Dakota provides corporate crypto banking, yield-bearing USD treasury accounts, and global payment rails designed specifically for Web3 startups, protocols, and DAOs.

nascent.name: Nascent
nascent.description: Nascent, founded in 2020 by Dan Elitzer and a small team in the US with offices in New York and San Francisco, operates as a crypto venture fund and builder collective that combines early-stage investing with technical building. The firm backs founders across DeFi, infrastructure and AI while contributing code, mechanism design and protocol research hands-on as a venture builder rather than a passive allocator. Headquartered with a distributed partnership across the US, Nascent emphasizes deep diligence, founder alignment and open-source contributions to portfolio projects. The team blends investing, engineering and cryptography expertise to support launches from research through mainnet and governance. Expect an intellectually curious culture that values builder empathy, rigorous evaluation and rolling up sleeves alongside founders to tackle hard technical problems.

altitudedp.name: Altitude Development Partners
altitudedp.description: Altitude Development Partners is a venture studio, technology studio, and dedicated decentralized finance hedge fund founded in 2018. Built around systems engineering, quantitative research, and production-grade software delivery, the firm designs and executes systematic trading strategies across decentralized protocols and traditional financial markets. Altitude specializes in quantitative yield modeling, protocol and MEV analysis, liquidity dynamics, and automated risk systems, spanning from raw on-chain data pipelines to defended smart contract execution. Operating as a globally distributed team with high ownership standards, Altitude unites quantitative researchers, protocol engineers, and systems developers who build institutional DeFi and financial technology infrastructure.

digital-asset.name: Digital Asset
digital-asset.description: Digital Asset, founded in 2014 in New York by Yuval Rooz, Sunil Hirani and Don Wilson with Shaul Kfir and Eric Saraniecki, builds Canton Network and the Daml smart contract language for regulated financial markets. Canton enables privacy-preserving tokenization of bonds, repos and derivatives where participants share only data necessary to settle, used by firms including Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas and Deutsche Börse. Headquartered in New York with hubs in Zurich, London and Hong Kong, Digital Asset blends Wall Street engineering with Web3 privacy and formal modeling. Backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs and Citigroup, the company focuses on production-grade delivery for capital markets and interoperable networks. The platform supports issuance, clearing and asset servicing with rigorous operational and compliance controls for institutions globally.

blackbird-labs.name: Blackbird Labs
blackbird-labs.description: Blackbird Labs, founded in 2022 by Ben Leventhal, co-founder of Eater and Resy, in New York, builds consumer payments and loyalty infrastructure for restaurants using stablecoins and blockchain rails. Its products include Blackbird Pay for checkout, Flynet loyalty points and membership tools that let diners earn and redeem rewards across independent restaurants without interchange-heavy cards. Headquartered in New York with hubs in Los Angeles, Blackbird bridges hospitality operations with on-chain settlement, treasury and compliance behind familiar app UX. The platform targets restaurant operators seeking lower fees, direct relationships and data ownership. Backed by leading investors in hospitality and crypto, the team combines restaurant tech and Web3 expertise. Expect a product and partnership-driven culture that values hospitality craft, payments reliability and making blockchain invisible to everyday dining experiences.

liminal-custody.name: Liminal
liminal-custody.description: Liminal Custody provides institutional wallet and custody infrastructure for digital assets, combining MPC key management, policy engines, and operational controls for exchanges, funds, and corporate treasuries. Its platform supports multi-chain asset coverage, transaction approvals, and integrations with trading and settlement systems that require segregated accounts. Liminal focuses on security architecture, auditability, and workflows that map to institutional compliance expectations. Teams span engineering, security, client onboarding, and support across India and global remote hubs. Expect a custody-first culture that values key ceremony discipline, uptime, and helping clients move assets on-chain without sacrificing control or policy oversight.

etoro.name: eToro
etoro.description: eToro, founded in 2007 in Tel Aviv by Yoni Assia with brothers Ronen Assia and David Ring as RetailFX, operates a social investing platform serving millions of registered users across many countries. The platform offers stocks, exchange-traded funds, crypto assets and copy trading that lets users replicate strategies of experienced investors, plus educational resources and community feeds. Regulated by authorities including the Financial Conduct Authority, CySEC and ASIC, and publicly listed on Nasdaq, eToro emphasizes transparent product design and responsible access to markets. Headquartered in Tel Aviv with hubs in London, Hoboken, Limassol and Sydney and operations across Europe and the Middle East, the company values community learning, behavioral insights and building collaborative investing experiences for retail and experienced traders alike.

venice-ai.name: Venice AI
venice-ai.description: Venice AI has 1 active role listed on Hashtag Web3. Current openings include Senior Paralegal, Contracts and Corporate.

fin.name: Fin
fin.description: Fin is an institutional-grade digital asset trading, settlement, and compliance infrastructure platform built for professional capital markets. Operating across low-latency decentralized networks and regulated liquidity venues, Fin provides hedge funds, proprietary trading desks, and asset managers with unified execution, deep liquidity aggregation, real-time risk controls, and automated post-trade settlement. By combining institutional custody standards with high-throughput onchain rails, Fin enables professional market participants to deploy capital into digital assets with institutional reliability and regulatory transparency.

franklin-templeton.name: Franklin Templeton
franklin-templeton.description: Franklin Templeton is a global asset management leader pioneering tokenized money market funds (FOBXX), blockchain asset management, and institutional digital asset strategies across Public, Private, and Decentralized Financial Markets.

lightning-labs.name: Lightning Labs
lightning-labs.description: Lightning Labs, founded in 2016 by Elizabeth Stark and Olaoluwa Osuntokun in San Francisco, builds core infrastructure for Bitcoin and the Lightning Network. Its flagship implementation LND powers a majority of Lightning nodes, enabling instant, low-fee bitcoin payments, while Taproot Assets extends Lightning to issue stablecoins and tokens on Bitcoin. The company also provides Lightning Loop, Pool and Faraday tools for liquidity management and node operations serving developers, wallets and exchanges worldwide. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, Lightning Labs is backed by leading investors and stewards open-source development alongside protocol research. The team champions Bitcoin scalability through careful protocol design. Expect an engineering-heavy, research-informed culture that values peer review, reliability and extending Bitcoin for everyday payments globally today.

meow.name: Meow
meow.description: Meow's mission is to make business banking better, according to its about page. Meow is a financial technology company, not a bank, offering modern business banking for global companies with onboarding that does not require paperwork or upfront commitment. Its team serves venture-backed companies and builds accounts, payments, and treasury tools described on meow.com for startups and growing businesses.

sentient.name: Sentient
sentient.description: Sentient is an AI and blockchain research organization building open infrastructure for decentralized artificial intelligence, including protocols that coordinate model access, inference, and incentives across distributed contributors. Its work targets transparent, community-governed AI systems that can run with cryptographic guarantees instead of fully centralized model APIs. Teams combine machine learning research, distributed systems engineering, and protocol design for early-stage products still moving toward production networks. Expect a research-heavy culture that values open collaboration, careful experimentation, and bridging AI capabilities with on-chain coordination mechanisms.

modern-treasury.name: Modern Treasury
modern-treasury.description: Modern Treasury is a multi-rail payment service provider for fiat and stablecoin flows. Its site describes launching in days with one API, sub-accounts, and built-in compliance across ACH, RTP, FedNow, and wire. The company builds payment operations software and programmable money movement infrastructure for businesses that need auditable ledgers, reconciliation, and bank-rail connectivity alongside stablecoin payment capabilities.

r3.name: R3
r3.description: R3 is a leading enterprise distributed ledger technology and digital solutions firm behind Corda, a permissioned, scalable DLT platform purpose-built for regulated financial institutions. R3 works with central banks, global exchanges, tier-one banks, and asset managers to power central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), tokenized deposits, bond issuance, and cross-border settlement. Headquartered in London with offices in New York, Singapore, and São Paulo, R3 values financial regulatory compliance, enterprise software engineering, and institutional infrastructure. R3's Corda platform enables central banks and tier-one financial institutions to tokenized assets, deploy CBDCs, and automate cross-border settlement with enterprise-grade regulatory compliance.

d3-global.name: D3 Global
d3-global.description: D3 Global, founded by Fred Hsu in Las Vegas, is a next-generation domain name company pioneering the DomainFi movement by bridging traditional internet DNS infrastructure with Web3 digital identity. D3 collaborates with ICANN-accredited registries and leading Layer 1/Layer 2 ecosystems, including ApeChain, Shibarium, and Core DAO, to tokenize domain registries into authentic, verifiable on-chain identities that resolve seamlessly across standard web browsers, crypto wallets, and decentralized messaging protocols.

zodl.name: ZODL
zodl.description: Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL) is the team of engineers and product builders advancing the Zcash protocol and the Zodl mobile wallet for shielded payments. Formed by former Electric Coin Company contributors who originally created Zcash and the Zashi wallet, ZODL continues core protocol development alongside wallet features such as private ZEC transfers, swaps, cross-chain payments, and hardware-wallet support. The Zodl app is designed as a self-custodial interface for shielded Zcash with minimal tracking and transparent open-source development. Headquartered in Dallas with a distributed team across the United States and Europe, ZODL focuses on privacy-preserving financial technology that remains usable for mainstream audiences. Expect a cryptography-heavy culture that values protocol integrity, user sovereignty, and shipping wallet experiences that make private digital money practical.

moon.name: Moon
moon.description: Moon (paywithmoon.com) helps people spend digital assets in everyday commerce through Moon Visa® virtual cards, discounted merchant gift cards, and payments infrastructure for consumers and partners. Shoppers can fund cards with Bitcoin, Lightning, Tether (USDT), USDC, or Ether and receive USD-denominated balances for online checkout where Visa is accepted. Moon markets instant card delivery, encrypted handling of user data, and a non-custodial model for card usage. The product line also includes prepaid and merchant-branded gift cards purchased with crypto, plus business-facing resources such as API documentation and partner programs. The company highlights fee-conscious card loading, broad wallet compatibility across on-chain and Lightning rails, and content and education around virtual credit cards and stablecoin payments.

tenderly.name: Tenderly
tenderly.description: Tenderly is an all-in-one Web3 development and observability platform used by over 300,000 blockchain developers and top DeFi protocols. Tenderly provides real-time smart contract monitoring, zero-latency node infrastructure, transaction simulation, visual debugger, and automated alerting across 30+ EVM networks. Backed by Accel and Spark Capital, Tenderly eliminates guesswork in smart contract development and incident response. The culture prizes developer experience, distributed backend scalability, and deep EVM tooling. Tenderly's Web3 developer platform provides real-time smart contract monitoring, transaction simulation, visual debugging, and node infrastructure for over 300,000 developers.

xsolla.name: Xsolla
xsolla.description: Xsolla provides commerce, payments, and monetization tools for game developers and publishers worldwide. The company operates payment rails, fraud controls, and distribution services connecting studios to global players. Web3-oriented teams build NFT marketplaces, wallet integrations, smart-contract payment flows, and blockchain game infrastructure for studios adopting digital assets. Engineering spans high-scale payments compliance and newer crypto-native product lines such as smart wallets and account abstraction.

m0.name: M0
m0.description: M0, founded in 2023 by Luca Prosperi, Gregory Di Prisco and Oliver Schimek with headquarters in Zug, Switzerland, builds decentralized infrastructure for issuing custom stablecoins. Its protocol provides a federated layer where approved minters collateralize and issue M tokens backed by short-term Treasuries, with governance over collateral and rate parameters. Headquartered in Zug with distributed contributors across the US and Europe, M0 targets fintechs, funds and protocols that want branded dollar liabilities without building issuance from scratch. The design separates Minting, Collateral and Governance, emphasizing transparency, daily attestation and composability with DeFi. Still scaling mainnet adoption and partner integrations, it focuses on open, extensible money. Backed by Pantera Capital and Ribbit Capital, it operates as neutral plumbing. Expect a research and mechanism-design culture that values risk rigor, governance thoughtfulness and enabling diverse stablecoin builders.

sfox.name: SFOX
sfox.description: SFOX is a cryptocurrency prime brokerage and trading platform serving institutional and professional traders with aggregated liquidity, smart order routing, and post-trade settlement across major venues. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Los Angeles, SFOX connects hedge funds, family offices, and proprietary desks to deep crypto markets with reporting and risk tools designed for regulated-adjacent workflows. Engineering and operations teams maintain low-latency connectivity, wallet segregation, and compliance processes that support large block trades and systematic strategies in digital assets.

1inch.name: 1inch
1inch.description: 1inch Network (1inch.com) is a leading decentralized exchange (DEX) aggregator and Web3 ecosystem protocol engineered to discover the most efficient swap routes across decentralized liquidity sources. Powered by the 1inch Aggregation Protocol, Limit Order Protocol, and Fusion mode (intent-based gasless swaps), 1inch aggregates liquidity across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, Base, and major Layer 2 networks. With over $400B+ in lifetime trading volume, 1inch offers retail traders, institutions, and Web3 developers deep liquidity, minimal slippage, MEV protection, and high-performance developer APIs.

coinmarketcap.name: CoinMarketCap
coinmarketcap.description: CoinMarketCap, founded in 2013 by Brandon Chez in New York, became the most visited crypto price-tracking site for prices, volumes and portfolio metrics. Now a subsidiary of Binance since 2020, CoinMarketCap aggregates data across numerous exchanges for coins, DeFi, NFTs and derivatives while maintaining editorial independence, rankings and research content. Headquartered in Dover, Delaware, with a globally distributed team, the platform serves a broad audience of consumers and professionals referencing its data for trading and media. Its methodology emphasizes transparent scoring, API access and educational content rather than trading venue operation. The business monetizes through advertising, APIs and events. Its research, newsletters and conference presence extend beyond aggregation to provide educational content that helps newcomers interpret market structure and on-chain signals. Expect a data and audience-focused culture that values coverage breadth, editorial neutrality and delivering accessible market information for everyday crypto users worldwide.

mantle-network.name: Mantle Network
mantle-network.description: Mantle Network is a high-performance Ethereum Layer 2 built around an optimistic rollup stack with modular data availability and a large treasury-backed ecosystem fund. Developers deploy EVM-compatible smart contracts with lower fees and faster confirmation times while inheriting Ethereum security assumptions. Mantle’s ecosystem spans DeFi, gaming, and consumer applications supported by grants, liquidity programs, and tooling from the Mantle governance community. Core contributors focus on sequencer reliability, fraud-proof infrastructure, and developer experience parity with Ethereum mainnet. Expect a builder-oriented L2 culture that values throughput engineering, ecosystem growth, and shipping scalable applications for mainstream users.

codex.name: Codex
codex.description: Codex, based in San Francisco, builds modern programmatic stablecoin settlement rails and cross-border treasury infrastructure for global internet businesses. Codex replaces slow legacy correspondent banking networks with real-time, low-cost digital dollar transactions (USDC, USDT), enabling marketplaces, software platforms, and global enterprises to invoice, collect, and settle payments worldwide with automated domestic bank off-ramps.

matter-labs.name: Matter Labs
matter-labs.description: Matter Labs, founded in December 2018 by Alex Gluchowski and Alexandr Vlasov in Berlin, develops ZKsync, the ZK-rollup ecosystem for Ethereum scaling. Its flagship ZKsync Era uses zero-knowledge proofs for validity-based settlement, account abstraction and low gas fees, complemented by ZK Stack for builders launching custom ZK chains and Prividium for enterprise privacy. The team emphasizes open-source development, proof system advances and EVM compatibility for easy migration. Headquartered in Berlin with hubs in New York and globally remote, Matter Labs is backed by leading investors and supports millions through ecosystem wallets and apps. The company works closely with researchers on recursive proofs and prover efficiency. Expect an engineering-heavy culture focused on cryptographic excellence, developer experience and scaling Ethereum without compromising security or user self-custody.

magic-eden.name: Magic Eden
magic-eden.description: Magic Eden, founded in 2021 by Jack Lu, Sidney Zhang, Zhuoxun Yin and Zhuojie Zhou in San Francisco, operates a leading multichain NFT and digital collectibles marketplace spanning Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin Ordinals. Its platform offers launchpad, aggregation, wallet and creator royalty tooling for trading, minting and managing collections with low fees and fast indexing. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, Magic Eden grew from a Solana-native marketplace to a cross-chain venue serving a broad collector base and thousands of creators. Emphasizing curation, discovery and pro-trader features, it supports both retail and professional workflows with mobile and API access. Backed by leading investors, it invests in marketplace infra and creator grants. Expect a fast-moving, marketplace-driven culture that values creator relationships, product iteration and reliable trading at NFT scale.

sei-labs.name: Sei Labs
sei-labs.description: Sei Labs is the core developer of Sei Network, a high-throughput Layer 1 blockchain engineered specifically for digital asset trading, DEXs, and high-frequency Web3 applications. Featuring built-in order matching engines, sub-second finality, and parallelized EVM execution (Sei v2), Sei Labs brings Wall Street-grade trading speed to decentralized finance. Built with parallelized execution and specialized consensus mechanics, Sei Network delivers sub-second transaction finality and Wall Street-grade orderbook throughput for high-frequency Web3 trading applications. Sei Labs empowers developers to launch high-performance DEXs, perpetual futures markets, and gaming protocols with native EVM compatibility and built-in matching engines. Sei's architecture optimizes orderbook liquidity, sub-second execution, and high-concurrency smart contract throughput, bringing Wall Street-grade trading infrastructure to the Web3 ecosystem.

li-fi.name: LI.FI
li-fi.description: LI.FI operates a cross-chain liquidity and bridging aggregation layer that routes swaps and transfers across major EVM and non-EVM networks through a single integration surface. Developers embed LI.FI to offer users the best-available bridge and DEX path without maintaining dozens of chain-specific integrations. The platform combines routing, slippage controls, and status tracking for wallets, dApps, and on-ramps that need dependable multichain UX. Headquartered with a distributed engineering team across Europe, LI.FI focuses on execution quality and safety checks around third-party bridges. Expect a developer-first culture centered on interoperability research, integration support, and making cross-chain transfers feel as simple as single-chain swaps.

openzeppelin.name: OpenZeppelin
openzeppelin.description: OpenZeppelin, founded in 2015 by Demian Brener and Manuel Araoz in the United States with a globally distributed team, defines the security standard for smart contract development. Its open-source Contracts library is the most widely used collection of audited Solidity primitives for tokens, governance and access control, while its Defender platform and audit practice secure mission-critical systems for leading DeFi protocols and financial institutions. Originally known as Zeppelin and founded in Buenos Aires, the company pioneered formal smart contract audits and education through Ethernaut. Headquartered in the United States with teams across 30+ countries, OpenZeppelin operates as a security-first product and services firm emphasizing research, formal verification and continuous monitoring. Its work underpins a significant share of value secured on Ethereum and L2s. Backed by leading investors, it advances open, reusable standards. Expect a rigorous, audit-minded culture that values code correctness, clear documentation and stewardship of shared infrastructure.

monad-foundation.name: Monad Foundation
monad-foundation.description: Monad Foundation, established in December 2024 to steward the Monad blockchain originally built by Monad Labs, supports the parallel EVM Layer 1 community. The Foundation administers grants, ecosystem programs and governance coordination independent of Monad Labs' commercial engineering, funding research on parallel execution, MonadBFT and EVM compatibility. Headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands, with a globally distributed team and contributor hubs in New York, the Foundation coordinates testnet participation, validator programs and developer onboarding for DeFi and gaming builders migrating Ethereum contracts. The network targets high throughput and low gas fees without rewriting tooling. Governed as open infrastructure, it emphasizes decentralization and ecosystem neutrality. Expect a collaborative, ecosystem-focused culture centered on performance research, developer support and expanding practical infrastructure for demanding on-chain workloads.

groma.name: Groma
groma.description: Groma is a real estate technology and tokenization platform that enables fractional ownership of residential real estate assets through blockchain rails. By combining property management, automated rental distribution, and digital asset security, Groma democratizes access to institutional-grade real estate investments. Groma tokenizes residential real estate assets on blockchain rails, empowering retail investors with fractional property ownership, automated rent distribution, and property management. By combining transparent property administration, digital asset security, and smart contract distribution, Groma democratizes access to institutional-grade real estate portfolios. Groma tokenizes residential real estate portfolios on public blockchains, enabling fractional ownership, automated rental distributions, and transparent property asset management.

capco.name: Capco
capco.description: Capco is a global technology and management consultancy specialized in banking, capital markets, and payments transformation. Digital assets and blockchain practices advise institutions on tokenization, stablecoin operations, wallet infrastructure, and regulatory compliance alongside core banking programs. Capco deploys cross-functional teams of business analysts, architects, and engineers at tier-one financial institutions. Digital asset roles on Capco boards focus on blockchain product design, DvP settlement, and operational models for banks entering crypto markets.

category-labs.name: Category Labs
category-labs.description: Category Labs, founded in 2022 by a small research collective with hubs in New York and San Francisco and closely associated with Monad ecosystem development, builds foundational research and tooling for high-performance blockchains. Operating as an early contributor group alongside Monad Labs, Category focuses on parallel execution, consensus optimization and formal verification for next-generation EVM networks. Headquartered with a distributed research team, Category contributes open-source libraries, testnet tooling and mechanism studies that inform Monad and broader EVM scaling efforts. The team blends academic research with shipping production chain upgrades. Governed as a builder collective rather than a custodial company, it emphasizes peer review and reproducible benchmarks. Expect a research-intensive culture that values distributed systems rigor, measured performance and collaborative advancement of scalable EVM infrastructure.

luxor-technology.name: Luxor Technology
luxor-technology.description: Luxor Technology, founded in 2020 by Nick Hansen, Eddie Wang, Ethan Vera and Guzman Pintos in Seattle, provides Bitcoin mining software and services. Its stack includes Luxor Pool, one of the largest US mining pools with full-Pay-Per-Share and hashrate derivatives, plus firmware LuxOS for ASIC optimization and Hashrate Index for market data. Headquartered in Seattle with hubs in Austin and globally distributed, Luxor serves industrial miners with uptime monitoring, firmware tuning and energy-aware tooling. The platform handles significant hashrate across North America and emphasizes open hashrate markets, low fees and miner profitability analytics. Backed by leading mining investors, the team blends mining operations, data and trading expertise. Expect an engineering-heavy culture focused on mining economics, fleet optimization and transparent tooling for professional mining operations.

gauntlet.name: Gauntlet
gauntlet.description: Gauntlet, founded in 2018 by Tarun Chitra, a former D. E. Shaw researcher, with Rei Chiang and John Morrow in New York, provides quantitative risk management and optimization for DeFi protocols. Its simulation platform models market, liquidity and liquidation risk to recommend parameter changes for lenders including Aave, Compound and Uniswap, protecting billions in TVL with data-driven proposals. Using agent-based simulations and formal methods, Gauntlet acts as an independent risk partner for DAOs and foundations. Headquartered in New York with a distributed research team, Gauntlet is backed by leading investors including Paradigm and Ribbit. The team blends finance, engineering and data science. Expect an analytical culture that prizes rigorous modeling, clear communication with governance communities and accountable stewardship of protocol risk.

ckba.name: CKBA
ckba.description: The Common Knowledge Base Association (CKBA) is a Swiss non-profit membership association that supports the Common Knowledge Base (CKB) blockchain ecosystem through open-source coordination, contributor governance, and ecosystem programs. CKBA helps fund public-goods development, community initiatives, and education for builders working on CKB’s layered architecture and Nervos stack. The association is governed by its members rather than a single corporate sponsor, with emphasis on transparent stewardship of shared infrastructure. Teams span developer relations, grants, events, and partnerships that connect protocol researchers with application developers. Expect a community-oriented culture that values open collaboration, long-horizon protocol work, and growing decentralized participation in CKB’s network.

lightspark.name: Lightspark
lightspark.description: Lightspark, founded in 2022 by David Marcus, former Meta Novi lead, with a senior team from Meta, in Los Angeles, builds enterprise infrastructure for Bitcoin's Lightning Network. Its platform, Lightspark Predict and Lightspark Connect, offers node management, liquidity automation, routing optimization and compliant wallet SDKs that let exchanges, neobanks and wallets send instant low-fee bitcoin payments without operating Lightning directly. Headquartered in Los Angeles with hubs in Austin and remote, Lightspark integrates with banking rails, stablecoin issuance and compliance tooling to bring programmable money to mainstream apps. Backed by leading investors, the team applies consumer-scale payments expertise to Bitcoin. Its tools integrate compliance, risk and reporting that let banks launch compliant Lightning wallets, streaming payments and enterprise treasury flows. Expect a product and infrastructure culture that values reliability, regulatory thoughtfulness and extending Bitcoin for everyday global payments.

anza.name: Anza
anza.description: Anza, founded in 2024 as an independent spinout from Solana Labs by former core engineers in San Francisco, stewards core Solana protocol development including the Agave validator client. Formed to decentralize client development alongside Firedancer and Jito, Anza focuses on networking, runtime, consensus and performance improvements for the Solana network. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed engineering team, the firm was created with backing from Solana ecosystem stakeholders to ensure long-term protocol resilience and client diversity. Its work includes feature activation, testing and validator tooling used by the global validator set running mainnet. Operating as a research and engineering lab, Anza contributes open-source upgrades and performance research. Expect a low-level systems culture that prizes protocol correctness, validator empathy and shipping careful, high-impact changes for a live high-throughput network.

localcoin.name: Localcoin
localcoin.description: Localcoin operates one of North America's largest physical cryptocurrency ATM networks, providing thousands of retail kiosk locations across Canada and the United States. Localcoin enables everyday consumers to buy and sell Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital assets instantly with physical cash through compliant, user-friendly terminals. Localcoin operates thousands of cash-to-crypto kiosk terminals across North America, giving everyday consumers a compliant physical gateway to trade digital assets. Localcoin enables retail users to buy and sell Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital currencies instantly with cash through user-friendly retail kiosks integrated with local banking rails. Localcoin operates thousands of retail cash-to-crypto kiosk terminals across North America, providing a secure, compliant physical gateway for consumers to buy and sell Bitcoin.

sphere.name: Sphere
sphere.description: Sphere is an end-to-end crypto payments and billing infrastructure platform built on Solana, enabling businesses worldwide to accept stablecoins (USDC, EURC) with instant settlement and automated invoicing. Often described as the Stripe for Web3, Sphere offers payment links, developer SDKs, recurring subscriptions, on/off ramps, and automated tax accounting. Backed by leading fintech and crypto investors, Sphere combines developer-first documentation, high-speed payment processing, and rigorous compliance engineering. Sphere provides developer-friendly payment APIs, on-ramp integrations, and automated invoicing tools built on Solana, simplifying stablecoin checkout for internet businesses. Sphere simplifies stablecoin payments for internet businesses, providing developer-friendly APIs, on-ramp connectivity, and automated invoicing tools built on Solana.

shakepay.name: Shakepay
shakepay.description: Shakepay, founded in 2015 by Jean Amiouny and Roy Breidi in Montreal, operates Canada's leading consumer crypto app for buying, selling and paying with bitcoin and ether. Its products include Shakepay Wallet, recurring buys, bill pay, peer transfers and the Shakepay Card that lets users spend crypto balances at merchants with e-Transfer rails for CAD funding. Headquartered in Montreal with hubs in Toronto and remote across Canada, Shakepay emphasizes simple mobile UX, customer education and compliance under Canadian FINTRAC oversight rather than complex derivatives. Serving a broad retail base, the company navigates evolving regulation with a trust-first approach. Backed by growth capital, it focuses on reliable funding rails and support. Expect a customer-centric culture that values clarity, regulatory craft and expanding accessible, everyday crypto use for Canadians.

bcb-group.name: BCB Group
bcb-group.description: BCB Group, founded in 2019 by Oliver von Landsberg-Sadie and team in London, provides enterprise payments and trading infrastructure bridging crypto and fiat. Its core products, BCB Prime Services, BLINC instant settlement and treasury accounts, let crypto firms, market makers and fintechs hold, convert and move funds across GBP, EUR, USD and stablecoins with regulated payment rails. Headquartered in London with hubs in Paris and remote, BCB is authorized as a payments institution and serves institutions needing compliant banking access that traditional banks often avoid. The firm emphasizes settlement speed, reconciliation and auditability across banking and chain rails. Backed by leading investors, it operates as market infrastructure. Expect an operations and compliance-driven culture that values payments reliability, regulatory craft and enabling institutions to move value between banking and crypto seamlessly.

brale.name: Brale
brale.description: Brale is a regulated financial technology platform and licensed stablecoin issuer enabling businesses, fintechs, and financial institutions to create, deploy, and manage custom stablecoins backed by fiat and US Treasuries across multiple blockchain networks. Brale enables institutions and fintechs to issue, manage, and settle custom fiat-backed stablecoins across major blockchain networks with strict regulatory compliance. Operating as a licensed financial technology platform, Brale provides tokenization APIs, reserve auditability, and Treasury-backed asset issuance. Brale powers enterprise stablecoin liquidity and programmable fiat asset management for institutional digital finance.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.description: Gemini, founded in 2014 in New York by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, is a regulated US crypto exchange and custodian (NYDFS Trust) known for security and compliance, serving retail and institutions with spot, staking and custody. Gemini Custody holds $30B+ in assets and emphasizes SOC 2 and insurance. Headquartered in New York with hubs in London and Singapore, Gemini navigated the 2022 credit cycle to refocus on core exchange. The culture prizes security, regulatory craft and product quality. Gemini is a regulated cryptocurrency exchange and custodian founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, offering secure digital asset trading, Gemini Credit Card rewards, and SOC 2-certified custody.

turnkey.name: Turnkey
turnkey.description: Turnkey, founded in 2022 by Bryce Ferguson and Jack Kearney, former Coinbase engineers, in New York, provides low-level wallet infrastructure for developers. Its API abstracts private key generation, signing and policy enforcement into secure, scalable enclaves, letting apps spin up millions of non-custodial wallets with flexible permissions, social recovery and session keys. Used by exchanges, fintechs and on-chain games, Turnkey emphasizes sub-100ms signing, audited cryptography and fine-grained policies without exposing raw keys. Backed by leading investors including Sequoia and Variant, the company focuses on invisible infrastructure that makes crypto UX feel like Web2. Headquartered in New York with a remote US team, Turnkey operates with deep security expertise. Expect a high-trust engineering culture focused on key management rigor, developer experience and reliable operations.

walrus-foundation.name: Walrus Foundation
walrus-foundation.description: Walrus Foundation, established in 2024 to steward Walrus, is a decentralized storage and data availability protocol originally incubated by Mysten Labs, core builders of Sui in Zug and Palo Alto. Walrus decouples blob storage from computation, offering high-throughput, low-cost storage for large files, checkpoints and rollup data secured by delegated proof-of-stake. The Foundation, headquartered in Zug with global contributors, administers grants, validator programs and ecosystem growth independent of Mysten while coordinating upgrades and token governance. Emphasizing verifiable replication and erasure coding, Walrus targets AI, gaming and archiving workloads that exceed typical chain storage limits. Governed as open infrastructure, it supports Sui-native integrations and cross-chain tooling. Expect a collaborative, ecosystem-focused culture centered on storage reliability, open development and expanding practical decentralized infrastructure for data-intensive builders.

crypto-finance.name: Crypto Finance
crypto-finance.description: Crypto Finance, founded in 2017 by Jan Brzezek, Marc P. Bernegger and Tobias Reichmuth in Zug, delivers regulated institutional services for digital assets under Swiss FINMA oversight. As part of Deutsche Börse Group since its 2021 acquisition, it offers custody, staking, tokenization and brokerage for banks and professional investors via Crypto Storage AG and Crypto Brokerage. The group was among the first to receive a Swiss securities house license for crypto, enabling compliant access to trading and yield products. Headquartered in Zug with offices in Zurich, the firm connects traditional banking rails with on-chain settlement. Backed by Deutsche Börse and leading investors, it emphasizes audit, segregation and operational excellence. Expect a precise, compliance-first culture where engineers and risk teams collaborate closely with regulators and institutional clients.

airtm.name: Airtm
airtm.description: Airtm is a digital dollar account and cross-border payment platform serving over 1 million users across Latin America and emerging markets. Airtm enables freelancers, digital workers, and remote teams to receive payouts, hold USDC digital dollars, and cash out into local bank accounts with low fees. Airtm provides digital dollar accounts and cross-border payment rails for freelancers and remote workers in emerging markets, facilitating instant USDC payouts and bank settlement. Operating across Latin America and global markets, Airtm enables users to hold digital dollars, send payments, and convert funds into local bank accounts with minimal fees.

ellipsis-labs.name: Ellipsis Labs
ellipsis-labs.description: Ellipsis Labs, founded in 2023 by Eugene Chen and Jarry Xiao, ex-Citadel and Berkeley engineers, in New York, builds high-performance DeFi on Solana. Its flagship product Phoenix is an open, non-custodial limit orderbook DEX with on-chain settlement and instant finality, designed for professional market makers and retail traders seeking transparent liquidity. Complemented by Atlas, its validator infrastructure, Ellipsis focuses on low-latency, capital-efficient trading without intermediaries. Backed by leading investors including Paradigm and Electric Capital, the team applies traditional finance market structure expertise to on-chain venues. Headquartered in New York with a lean engineering team, Ellipsis emphasizes correctness and speed. Expect a rigorous, performance-obsessed culture that values market microstructure knowledge, security and shipping reliable trading systems in volatile markets every day.

veda.name: Veda
veda.description: Veda, founded in 2024 by Sun Raghupathi and collaborators in New York, builds institutional vault infrastructure for DeFi yield. Its platform, Veda Vaults, abstracts cross-chain staking, restaking and DeFi strategies behind tokenized vaults that handle rebalancing, risk management and accounting for fintechs and asset managers. Designed to let apps offer yield without running keeper infrastructure, Veda integrates with custodians, bridges and protocols while preserving non-custodial controls and audited strategies. Headquartered in New York with a distributed team, Veda operates at the intersection of DeFi and traditional asset management, emphasizing operational safety, liquidity and transparent reporting. Early deployments power vaults across Ethereum and L2s for a growing partner base. Expect a risk-aware, product-focused culture that values DeFi composability, institutional reliability and simplifying yield delivery for builders and allocators.

metropolis.name: Metropolis
metropolis.description: Metropolis is a technology company modernizing parking payments and mobility commerce with computer vision, membership, and contactless checkout for garages and venues. Operators and engineers build hardware-software systems that recognize vehicles, automate billing, and integrate with consumer wallets. A subset of roles references Web3 or digital wallet integrations as Metropolis explores modern payment rails. The company scales operations across U.S. metros with product, field engineering, and partnership teams.

project44.name: project44
project44.description: project44 provides a supply-chain visibility platform connecting shippers, carriers, and logistics partners with real-time tracking and analytics. Enterprise engineers build API integrations, data pipelines, and predictive ETA models across global freight networks. Occasional roles reference blockchain pilots, trade finance, or digitized document workflows where distributed ledgers support logistics transparency. project44 serves Fortune 500 shippers with cloud-native architecture and operational reliability as primary engineering values.

0x.name: 0x
0x.description: 0x, founded in 2017 by Will Warren and Amir Bandeali in San Francisco, develops open exchange infrastructure for Ethereum and EVM chains. Its product suite includes 0x Protocol for order settlement, 0x API and Tx Relay for aggregated swap routing and gasless execution, and on-chain RFQ via Periscope that power wallets like Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet and Matcha. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, 0x abstracts liquidity across decentralized exchanges behind a single API that handles routing, slippage and MEV protection for developers. Audited and governed as open infrastructure, 0x emphasizes performance, reliability and economic efficiency. Expect an engineering-driven culture that values routing correctness, developer experience and building invisible exchange rails that make trading feel simple and fair.

notabene.name: Notabene
notabene.description: Notabene, founded in 2020 by Pelle Brændgaard, Ania Lipinska and Andres Dupont with headquarters in New York, provides Travel Rule compliance infrastructure for crypto. Its platform, SafeTransact and dashboard, automates peer VASP discovery, secure data exchange and reconciliation that helps exchanges and wallets meet FATF Travel Rule obligations when transferring assets between institutions. Serving exchanges, custodians and banks across numerous jurisdictions, Notabene handles encrypted identity exchange, Sunrise assessments and reporting without exposing consumer data on-chain. Headquartered in New York with offices in Berlin and Lisbon, Notabene emphasizes interoperability, data privacy and regulator-ready audit trails. Backed by leading investors, it operates as SaaS rather than custody. Expect a compliance and privacy-focused culture that values secure data engineering, regulatory engagement and enabling institutions to transfer assets safely and compliantly.

xapo-bank.name: Xapo Bank
xapo-bank.description: Xapo Bank, originally founded in 2013 as Xapo by Wences Casares in Palo Alto and now headquartered in Gibraltar, operates a licensed private bank integrating Bitcoin custody with traditional banking. As a Gibraltar-regulated bank and supervised VASP, it offers insured Bitcoin custody in underground vaults, interest on bitcoin and USD accounts with dedicated IBANs, plus card spending. Serving high-net-worth members and institutions globally, Xapo emphasizes security through deep cold storage, multi-party computation and inheritance planning. Licensed in Gibraltar with members across many countries, it bridges private banking discretion with Bitcoin conviction. Backed by leading investors including Greylock and Index, Xapo maintains a selective membership model. Expect a security-first culture that values privacy, long-term custody thinking and combining bank-grade compliance with Bitcoin-native product.

axiom.name: Axiom
axiom.description: Axiom is a zero-knowledge coprocessor for Ethereum that provides smart contracts with trustless access to historical blockchain data and compute. By generating ZK-SNARK proofs of past state, transactions, and receipts, Axiom enables developers to build data-rich dApps, retroactive rewards, on-chain identity systems, and dynamic DeFi without relying on centralized oracles. Backed by top crypto venture firms, Axiom combines cutting-edge cryptography with developer-first tooling. The engineering bar emphasizes applied cryptography, halo2 circuit design, and EVM internals. Axiom utilizes ZK-SNARK proofs to give Ethereum smart contracts trustless access to historical blockchain data, enabling data-rich dApps and dynamic DeFi applications.

bitmama.name: Bitmama
bitmama.description: Bitmama provides a platform for buying, selling, and managing cryptocurrencies. Its services also include crypto payment cards and transfers of fiat money and digital assets.

dialectic.name: Dialectic
dialectic.description: Dialectic combines machine intelligence with crypto-native financial infrastructure. Its work includes agentic DeFi, automated yield strategies, and deep-technology venture investing.

ginco.name: Ginco
ginco.description: Ginco develops blockchain infrastructure and tools for businesses building Web3 services. Its products include an enterprise crypto wallet, wallet monitoring tools, a blockchain cloud platform, and a self-custodial mobile wallet.

nous-research.name: Nous Research
nous-research.description: Nous Research, founded in 2023 by a distributed collective of AI researchers and open-source contributors, builds decentralized AI models and training infrastructure for open, aligned intelligence.
